releaseItems.title: Implement FleetNet customer creation wizard (General → Financial → Departments → Notes)
Enforce mandatory field validation across all FleetNet wizard steps
Support Volume Group, Bill Group and Card Group assignment on General step
Add Customer Lock Status and Lock Reason handling
Add Customer / Fleet Search by Customer ID
Validate Price Reference Code and Amount on Financial step
Support Department creation and "Access IFleet To Maintain Departments" handoff link

testCases.scenario: Access FleetNet customer creation entry point
testCases.precondition: User is logged into MDUI with a valid session.
testCases.expectedResult: The creation wizard opens on the General step.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises navigation only.

testCases.scenario: Verify all four wizard steps are present
testCases.precondition: The FleetNet customer creation wizard is open.
steps: Review the step indicator across the top of the wizard.
testCases.expectedResult: General, Financial, Departments, and Notes are listed in that order.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises layout only.

testCases.scenario: Complete General step with valid data
testCases.precondition: User is on the General step.
steps: Select Licensee, System, Division, and Account Product Type.
testCases.expectedResult: The wizard advances to the Financial step.
testCases.testDataRequirement: 1 Licensee with a valid Division and Account Product Type.

testCases.scenario: Complete Financial step with valid pricing
testCases.precondition: User has advanced to the Financial step.
steps: Enter a valid Price Reference Code and Amount.
testCases.expectedResult: The wizard advances to the Departments step.
testCases.testDataRequirement: A valid Price Reference Code and Amount configured in reference data.

testCases.scenario: Verify Departments step loads without error
testCases.precondition: User has advanced to the Departments step.
testCases.expectedResult: The Departments step loads without error (baseline, pre-empty-state-clarification).
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises navigation only.

testCases.scenario: Complete Notes step and save
testCases.precondition: User has completed General, Financial, and Departments.
testCases.expectedResult: The FleetNet customer record is created successfully.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None beyond the record being built through the prior steps.

testCases.scenario: Verify backward navigation between wizard steps
testCases.precondition: User has advanced from General to Financial.
testCases.expectedResult: The wizard returns to the General step with previously entered data retained.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None beyond the record being built through the General step.

testCases.scenario: Verify mandatory field indicators appear on General step
testCases.precondition: User is on the General step with mandatory fields empty.
testCases.expectedResult: Empty mandatory fields are outlined in red and the wizard does not advance.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises validation only.

testCases.scenario: Verify FleetNet customer record persists after wizard completion
testCases.precondition: A FleetNet customer has just been created.
testCases.expectedResult: All previously entered data is displayed correctly.
testCases.testDataRequirement: The FleetNet customer created earlier in this scenario.

testCases.scenario: End-to-end wizard completion regression
testCases.precondition: No pre-existing FleetNet customer for this test's Customer Name.
steps: Complete General, Financial, Departments, and Notes steps in full.
testCases.expectedResult: The record is created with no errors across any step.
testCases.testDataRequirement: A clean environment with no pre-existing FleetNet customer for this test's Customer Name.

testCases.scenario: Validate missing General mandatory fields
testCases.precondition: User is on the General step with mandatory fields empty.
steps: Leave Customer Name, Licensee, and Account Product Type empty.
testCases.expectedResult: Every empty mandatory field on General shows a red-border validation indicator.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises validation only.

testCases.scenario: Validate missing Financial mandatory fields
testCases.precondition: User is on the Financial step with Price Reference Code empty.
testCases.expectedResult: Price Reference Code shows a red-border validation indicator.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises validation only.

testCases.scenario: Validate Customer Lock Reason becomes mandatory when Locked
testCases.precondition: FleetNet customer exists with Lock Status Unlocked.
steps: Change Customer Lock Status to Locked.
testCases.expectedResult: Customer Lock Reason becomes a mandatory red-outlined field.
testCases.testDataRequirement: An existing FleetNet customer with Lock Status currently Unlocked.

testCases.scenario: Validate optional fields are never marked mandatory
testCases.precondition: User is on the General step.
steps: Review all optional fields with empty values.
testCases.expectedResult: No optional field displays a red-border required indicator.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises validation only.

testCases.scenario: Validate mandatory field state persists across step navigation
testCases.precondition: A mandatory field on General is left blank.
testCases.expectedResult: The validation indicator on the blank mandatory field is still shown.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises validation only.

testCases.scenario: Verify save is blocked when any step has unresolved mandatory fields
testCases.precondition: One wizard step has an incomplete mandatory field.
steps: Attempt to Save from the Notes step.
testCases.expectedResult: Save is blocked and the user is directed back to the incomplete step.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises validation only.

testCases.scenario: Assign a Volume Group on General step
testCases.precondition: User has completed required General fields.
testCases.expectedResult: The selected Volume Group is retained when the step is saved.
testCases.testDataRequirement: 1 existing Volume Group available for assignment.

testCases.scenario: Assign Bill Group and Card Group on General step
testCases.precondition: User has completed required General fields.
steps: Open the Bill Group selector and select a value.
Open the Card Group selector and select a value.
testCases.expectedResult: Both selections are retained when the step is saved.
testCases.testDataRequirement: 1 existing Bill Group and 1 existing Card Group available for assignment.

testCases.scenario: Verify group selectors show only active groups
testCases.precondition: At least one inactive Volume Group exists in reference data.
testCases.expectedResult: Only active Volume Groups are listed; inactive groups do not appear.
testCases.testDataRequirement: Reference data including at least one inactive Volume Group.

testCases.scenario: Verify group assignments are saved with the customer record
testCases.precondition: A FleetNet customer has been created with Volume, Bill, and Card Groups assigned.
testCases.expectedResult: All three group assignments persist and display correctly.
testCases.testDataRequirement: A FleetNet customer created with all three group types assigned.

testCases.scenario: Set Customer Lock Status to Locked
testCases.precondition: FleetNet customer exists with Lock Status Unlocked.
steps: Change Customer Lock Status to Locked.
testCases.expectedResult: Customer Lock Reason becomes a mandatory red-outlined field.
testCases.testDataRequirement: An existing FleetNet customer with Lock Status currently Unlocked.

testCases.scenario: Set Customer Lock Status back to Unlocked
testCases.precondition: FleetNet customer exists with Lock Status Locked and a Lock Reason set.
steps: Change Customer Lock Status to Unlocked.
testCases.expectedResult: Customer Lock Reason is no longer mandatory.
testCases.testDataRequirement: An existing FleetNet customer with Lock Status currently Locked.

testCases.scenario: Verify Lock Reason value persists when Locked
testCases.precondition: FleetNet customer is set to Lock Status Locked.
testCases.expectedResult: The entered Lock Reason is retained.
testCases.testDataRequirement: An existing FleetNet customer with Lock Status currently Locked.

testCases.scenario: Search by exact Customer ID
testCases.precondition: A FleetNet customer exists with a known Customer ID.
testCases.expectedResult: The matching customer record is returned.
testCases.testDataRequirement: An existing FleetNet customer with a known Customer ID.

testCases.scenario: Search by non-existent Customer ID
testCases.precondition: User is on the Customer / Fleet Search page.
steps: Enter a Customer ID that does not exist.
testCases.expectedResult: No results are returned and a clear no-match message is shown.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — a deliberately non-existent Customer ID.

testCases.scenario: Verify Customer ID search field is available
testCases.precondition: User is on the Customer / Fleet Search page.
testCases.expectedResult: A Customer ID field is visible alongside the existing search fields.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises layout only.

testCases.scenario: Validate missing Price Reference Code
testCases.precondition: User is on the Financial step with Price Reference Code empty.
testCases.expectedResult: Save is blocked and the field shows a red-border validation indicator.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises validation only.

testCases.scenario: Validate invalid Price Reference Code format
testCases.precondition: User is on the Financial step.
steps: Enter a malformed Price Reference Code.
testCases.expectedResult: A clear validation message is shown and the wizard does not advance.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises validation only.

testCases.scenario: Validate Price Reference Amount accepts only numeric values
testCases.precondition: User is on the Financial step.
steps: Enter a non-numeric value in Price Reference Amount.
testCases.expectedResult: The value is rejected with a clear validation message.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises validation only.

testCases.scenario: Verify Departments step shows Access iFleet handoff link
testCases.precondition: User has advanced to the Departments step.
testCases.expectedResult: The Access iFleet To Maintain Departments link is visible.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises layout only.

testCases.scenario: Verify the handoff link navigates to iFleet
testCases.precondition: User is on the Departments step.
steps: Click Access iFleet To Maintain Departments.
testCases.expectedResult: The user is navigated to iFleet's department maintenance area.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises navigation only.

testCases.scenario: Verify Departments step reflects departments maintained in iFleet
testCases.precondition: A department has just been added for this customer in iFleet.
steps: Return to the Departments step in MDUI.
testCases.expectedResult: The department maintained in iFleet is reflected on next load.
testCases.testDataRequirement: A FleetNet customer with a department maintained via iFleet.

testCases.scenario: Verify wizard matches baseline test scenario document layout
testCases.precondition: The FleetNet customer creation wizard is open.
steps: Compare each wizard step against the baseline test scenario document.
testCases.expectedResult: The wizard matches the documented baseline layout and step order.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises layout only.

testCases.scenario: Verify baseline regression scenario completes without error
testCases.precondition: No pre-existing FleetNet customer for this test's Customer Name.
steps: Execute the baseline document's end-to-end scenario in full.
testCases.expectedResult: The scenario completes successfully, matching the document's expected outcomes.
testCases.testDataRequirement: A clean environment with no pre-existing FleetNet customer for this test's Customer Name.

activityEvents.summary: Release closed — 8 of 8 stories shipped clean.
Test cases generated for Customer / Fleet Search — STORY-009.
Knowledge Assistant answered questions on FleetNet wizard field requirements.
